verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs extensively cover MCP as a client-side integration: connecting to external tools/data sources, marketplace one-click install with OAuth, custom JSON server configuration, per-server toggling, enterprise admin controls, image-return support, and MCP usage inside Cloud Agents (up to 50 inline mcpServers) and self-hosted workers ("local MCP servers"). This is corroborated by a live probe confirming documented MCP client behavior. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of MCP tool usage in practice beyond vendor docs.
